d: to be happy or content with what one has, with the implication of its being abundant
(a figurative extension of meaning of χορτάζομαι[a] ‘to eat one’s fill,’ {D:23.15}) to be satisfied or content with some object or state
to be happy or content as the result of having what one desires or needs to be
the state of being content with one’s circumstances or lot in life
pertaining to being happy or content with what one has
